Historical16-act search continuation under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve Q1–Q7, actor-per-verb and all withheld/later-reader rows. Source-issued/consumed/priced ration supports the selected native7-pence debit798→791; unmodeled other costs make791 an upper bound, not a complete source purse. Gun prices, hire rates, fares and commission terms are knowledge/facts here, not paid contracts, timed hired-carriage settlement or stock. Signed/held-copy facts and found floors do not instantiate a contract item or physical building. No new block place was minted; the player remains at the carriage place even while search notes refer to floors.

B5 dowsing is a free authored act with method facts, not an actual B5 method object; M1 commission, M2 time-hire and M3 medium-assisted dowsing remain proposals. One floor3 Spirit Vision tap is an actual metered use with3/0→2/1 pool/strain, not a whole unseen aura model. Leonard's two sequential visits/placed arrival and preflight correction supply this route, while the next window still needs to place him after floor3 departure. No fallback cut was needed; that means the16-intent window passed, not every requested mechanism was implemented.

One334.2-second run has three boots/one import plus per-act checkpoints; RESUME batching was available but unused. Final literal import followed by reload covers its actual ending state and retained earlier-window facts. It does not prove14/21 visual layout, civil clock, fresh entry, all disclosure or a new runtime build. A listed before-commit rules command is not an explicit result. B10 bundle/scratch-pack identity differs from current shared source. Leak assertions are selected-window/new-key sentinels rather than every possible observation. Current full-public-receipt review reads no private source/pack/seed/runtime/captures or actual personal save.

reviews.classification: bounded story evidence / retained economic palette / generator proposal qualifiers / known clock gap
reviews.disposition:
Full MG01–MG10 economic/management palette under AD5/AD31/AD32/AD38. Preserve the user's named investing/property interest separately from the proposed detailed loops. These can be ongoing livelihoods, not a universal quick minigame format or selected first implementation. Each world supplies actual institutions; no bank/stock market/deed/tenant-law prerequisite is imposed everywhere. MG01 distinguishes loan, equity, future-goods purchase and patronage; those create different actual rights/settlements. Real interventions can improve enterprise inputs. Supported foresight can be accurate without an arbitrary market exception; speculative reports do not expose hidden future outcomes by default.

MG02 separates ownership, occupancy, alteration and leasing, actual occupants/rooms/facilities, repair and choice of use. A home can be valuable with no rent; complaints/arrears need real causes rather than mandatory owner punishment. A deed's local institutional scope differs from physical carriage or a mechanism that genuinely carries jurisdiction/property. Heirs receive actual surviving rights, not automatically the same person/skill/self. MG03–MG10 retain shops/inns, appraisal/auction, caravan/shipping, farming/care, workshop capacity, lending/mutual aid, festivals/programs and collections/restoration with each actor/stock/history/delivery/delegation consumer. Do not collapse all into an interest timer or duplicate distributable payout.

The connected workshop/neighbor-room candidate is a proposal with pass/repair/fund/use/lease/lodging alternatives, not a required Frontier start or all-city simulation. Stock/cash reserves, mandates and escalation are actual delegation terms rather than NPC autonomy disappearing into an automation flag. Source of return, committed versus liquid holdings, own versus others' knowledge, clock/away policy and once-per-operation settlement remain exact gaps before any selected implementation. Proposed browser/persistence checks were not run. Useful specific interactions are folded into the existing economy/property owner with original IDs and backlink; this detailed source palette remains. No acquisition, real financial recommendation, gameplay feature, worker or new runtime authority follows from this review.

reviews.classification: bounded story evidence / retained economic palette / generator proposal qualifiers / known clock gap
reviews.disposition:
Full G1–G10 proposal review under AD5/AD8/AD22/AD32/AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51. Preserve authored canonical/reserved identities versus generated background people, individually essential unnamed roles, stable identity across encounters, promoted person history, and same-name disambiguation. Alias/catalog normalization is an authoring comparison, not a second actor or player disclosure. Curated culture/era/reading/source status and kind/capability/role/knowledge stay separate; a protagonist sample is not a demographic census, and a surname/grade/license does not grant practical means. Explicit source/acquisition history matters more than a global power number. Common name reuse is possible without silently replacing an established person.

Early one-realm/one-prestige implementation boundary and1366/1600 target guidance are superseded by current scope/desktop direction. The no-randomization/explicit-AU clauses are generation defaults protecting authored identity, not metaphysical impossibility or a requirement for creative-director permission whenever an actual in-world mechanism can produce a new relative, transferable role, special power or changed history. Canon baseline, authored overlay, causal divergence and explicit exceptional means keep their distinct source/actor implications; source-qualified genuinely unique conditions still matter. NPC leveling cannot be fabricated from player level, but real adaptive actors/mechanisms can respond to observed means. Every actor-in-one-instance phrasing describes this proposal's ordinary identity model, not a ban on supported multi-body/cross-world consciousness.

Keep actual household, duty, issuer/jurisdiction, stock/custody and relationship owners. Background generation does not mint merchandise from personal equipment, earn a salary or convey private plans because a title matches. Current evidence, attributed testimony, self-knowledge and author truth differ; visible clues need real reach/false-positive scope. Known trait counts, error strings, sorting/filters/CSS/ID structure can leak even without displaying an answer. Public franchise twists and sealed changed truths have different boundaries. A new grammar line cannot silently manufacture a canonical person/receipt. Keyed overlay replacement is distinct from appending rosters; saved names do not auto-reroll on reload/catalog revision.

Source labels and source quality are two axes: a secondary wiki assertion is not shown-primary, an author synopsis is not a population census, and a fan-world premise does not update the franchise baseline. The fixed examples/profile lists are not a complete reservation dictionary. Human fiction review is optional AD42, while actual saved useful interactions and changed later responses remain named proposed runtime evidence, not checks performed here or a new all-world gate. Full reading includes G8's previously truncated first paragraph recovered explicitly; no linked profiles/JSON/source books, hidden name maps or runtime tests were read/run. No population, grammar pack, start or world implementation is added.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B496: MG01–MG10 continuing livelihoods and property choices
folds.body:
Proposed MG01–MG10 interactions from the fully read [dispatch palette](gm/dispatch/minigames-2026-10-11/IDEAS_AT_DISPATCH.md), retained under AD5/AD31/AD32/AD38. Named investing/property interest is user direction; detailed implementations and the workshop/room first slice remain proposals, not runtime delivery or a required Frontier host.

MG01 separates loan/equity/future goods/patronage and allows actual repair/logistics/teaching/foresight to change outcomes. MG02 makes property a used place with actual people, facilities and distinct ownership/occupancy/alteration/lease rights; no universal arrears/maintenance punishment or rent requirement follows. Liquid money, stock, promises, accounts, rights and real distributable returns stay separate. A home may be useful without revenue; counterpart/heir identity and local deed authority follow real world mechanisms.

MG03 shop/inn stock and remembered customers; MG04 appraisal/auction evidence and bid limits; MG05 cargo/route/capacity/delivery; MG06 seasonal farming/care and storage; MG07 commissions sharing real stock/tools/capacity; MG08 lending/mutual aid and negotiated terms; MG09 event programs/attendance; MG10 restoration/collections/provenance each offers a distinct continuing livelihood. Their trained clerk, caretaker, bidder, caravan leader, farmhand, foreman, steward, organizer and conservator operate within actual mandate/means rather than silently duplicating funds or discarding others' choices. Banks, shares and tenant law are local possibilities, not prerequisites for all worlds.

Reopen a selected existing enterprise/occupant/stock/clock/settlement consumer when useful. The palette retains proposed fund/pass, actual contribution, settlement, room use, delegation and persistence checks; none was run by saving it. This fold adds no financial advice, source-world canon, new simulation owner or universally demanded whole-city economy.
